limits: One training seed42 and12 related recording groups; post-selection development diagnostics only.
All rows and all four trained candidate pairs retained; no outlier trimming or task-based reselection.
Pairwise whole-pool intervals use the unchanged pinned public helper; task slices are descriptive and are not separately tested.
Differential adaptation is an additive CE/accuracy point decomposition; no CI is inferred by subtracting pairwise bounds.
Relative NLL changes have different reference denominators and are not additive.
Does not establish a coding defect, three-seed qualification, or untouched scoring authorization.
Earlier exposed256-row4.18% NLL regression remains unchanged.
This descriptive analysis was run after development selection. The same development rows are not independent confirmation evidence.
Task labels replace raw questions. Row, recording-group, host, GPU and job identifiers are omitted; each comparison retains all twelve anonymous groups.
Exploratory intervals are not adjusted for thirteen comparisons or development selection. No per-task significance tests or outlier removal are performed.
Initial quantization effects and within-precision adapter gains are observations. Their additive point decomposition does not establish a causal training mechanism or a coding defect.
Relative percentage changes and independently computed interval bounds must not be subtracted to obtain an adaptation-effect interval.
Scored sequence lengths describe these development evaluations only. Multi-seed confirmation, independent diagnostic/regression scoring and general capability qualification remain separate.

resource_scope.postprocessing_memory_scope: Process-lifetime high-water RSS including startup history; not incremental diagnostic memory or model-training memory.
resource_scope.timing_limits: Queue wait is separate from allocated wall time. Scoring-stage wall includes imports, preprocessing/source checks, base loading, all rows and final integrity checks. It is not row-kernel time or training throughput.

scope.evaluation: Teacher-forced native supervised-token CE and restricted-choice/full-vocabulary first-answer-token diagnostics; not free generation.
